name: ruby-pg-control
description: Positive and negative controls written directly against the Ruby pg gem. correct reads PG::Result#cmd_status and reports a COMMIT error as a failure, not as a confirmed rollback. unsafe ignores the command tag and reports a raised COMMIT as a rollback. The modes are not harness kind control, so this adapter is not a second case-control gate and is not auto-run beside other adapters. expectations record the classifications the control is built to produce; the suite does not apply them as a gate.

modes.description: Positive control. Explicit BEGIN, parameterized writes, COMMIT or ROLLBACK. PG::Result#cmd_status of COMMIT must be COMMIT before the control reports committed. A tag of ROLLBACK is reported as rolled back. Any other tag, or a COMMIT that raises, is reported as failed. A failed ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT is followed by ROLLBACK, not COMMIT. A connection whose ROLLBACK failed is closed. BEGIN carries a requested isolation level. One PG::Connection, or a one-connection holder for TX-03. Not a framework pool.

Negative control. A COMMIT that does not raise is reported as committed, whatever cmd_status is. A COMMIT that raises is reported as rolled back. A failed savepoint rollback is ignored and the outer transaction is committed. A connection whose ROLLBACK failed is kept and handed to the next unit. A write made before a nested scope is sent inside that scope's savepoint. BEGIN ignores a requested isolation level.

TX-04.independent-inner.reason: The control has no propagation modes, so it has no API that promises an independent inner transaction, and the hazard TX-04.3 targets (pending outer writes committed by the inner transaction) cannot arise.
